title: A Blockchain-Enabled Federated Ensemble Framework for Privacy-Preserving Mortality Prediction Across Heterogeneous Healthcare Systems (code)
description: Code for the study 'A Blockchain-Enabled Federated Ensemble Framework for Privacy-Preserving Mortality Prediction Across Heterogeneous Healthcare Systems'. Hospitals commit SHA-256 digests of locally trained XGBoost and random-forest models to a Solidity smart contract, peers post digest-bound validation AUROCs, and the contract admits models whose median peer AUROC is at least 0.70. Includes comparators, attack scenarios, statistics and figures. No patient data are included; MIMIC-IV is available from PhysioNet to credentialed users.
